reviews.text:
Had a great first experience with my shaggy standard poodle, Winston.   He looks great!!!   Very impressed with his groom, Haley and everyone was super nice , seemed like they all worked together nicely!   Winston only took 3 hours and it’s one of his best haircuts!  Also really appreciated not being given any owner guilt about his temperament or how I should have come sooner, etc.  I’ve heard some things.   Got an appointment quickly, right before Christmas, and it was affordable!  I’ll be calling soon for his next groom!

Also, my dog came out of the groom totally happy and himself.  He was handled with love.   Thanks again!

EDIT:   Been coming for consistent cuts and EVERY TIME —- they do a great job with Winston’s cut and are super friendly.   Love these guys!!!   Thanks!

I’m so happy I found this place!
I have two elderly dogs one with severe special.They really did cater to my special-needs dog. They took their time with both of them. Both my dogs came home, smelling and looking fantastic and not stressed out at all. I highly recommend them and will be returning. Thank you again for taking care of my boys.
0 effort or attempt at workmanship on my parents dog, completely ruined the look of her, wouldn’t recommend if you don’t have a regular dog.
We absolutely adore this place! Highly recommended! Amanda has been taking care of our pup Luna for several years now, and always does a phenomenal job. They truly care for your pet, and it shows.
Would definitely recommend going if you need grooming or a nail trim for your dog! Really friendly, Hank gets nervous with nail trims but they did a great job keeping him relaxed and comfortable!
They're great with our two dogs! Always a good experience. Our Shiba can be a dick but he doesn't seem to mind it here

My dog was handled by Haley and they did a phenomenal job. ‘Bama was bathed. Cut. Nails trimmed. And her teeth brushed. Haley was the epitome of care and patience as well as talent and skill. They were within the time quoted and kind and courteous at drop off and pick up. Appreciate them and will def bring my ‘Bama Boo back again !
🖤

My dog Beau is very vocal and can be intimidating with her voice. We have been going to the Grooming Gallery for the last 4 years and the team has always taken excellent care of Beau and understands her boundaries! Beau had dry skin over the winter months and Eric suggested an oatmeal bath to help sooth the skin. She always comes home fresh and clean with the cutest bandanas. We love the grooming gallery!

We gave this place a try based on the recommendation by our vet and wanting to support a local business but won’t be back. After showing pics and giving explicit instructions—and saying exactly, do not shave her, call me with any issues—we returned to retrieve a stressed out, basically shaved mini bernedoodle, with no protection now in this cold.
Even weirder, we got this explanation from the groomer about the blade used and how she found a few mats on her chest and legs. So, why did she take our dog down so short all over? No sense at all or decency for the dog’s well-being. And somehow the appt took 2.5 hours for a washed and shaved dog, and we paid more for an “express” visit to have her only work on our pup. We’ll be telling our vet when we see her next not to recommend further. Extremely disappointed and furious.

Our dog (6 yo greyhound) is a nightmare about getting his nails trimmed but the folks at Grooming Gallery do an incredible job with him. He still hates it but they’re efficient, gentle, accommodating, and professional. The only thing that would make this place better would be an online booking system!
Were great with my dog May. Super quick and really friendly. Will definitely be back.
Good people, great service.

The Best grooming place!
I have been taking my cat Puyah here for 10 years and Amanda is the best with handling and grooming my cat. All of the staff is so welcoming and friendly. I’m so grateful to live close to the Grooming Gallery!!

Amanda grooms cats and shes awesome. She probly also works with dogs but as the owner of a super furry longhaired cat, amandas cat prowess is what i appreciate most. Awesomeness = be sure to book well ahead of date you need the grooming. SEPT 2025:Saw Amanda again last week. Still the best. Bring your cat here.

Stressful place for cats, don’t go here!

When the groomer in front called for Amanda to let her know I was here, she made like a groan noise.. it was rude. She said it should be 2-3 hours for a lions cut, but after the 3.5 hour mark I called to check in. She called me back and said she started late because a prior appointment, and my cat was doing well until he “got aggressive” with her. And then she adds it was probably because the another cat was hissing at him in the room. So… I was like well are there still other cats in the room? And she started rambling a bit about why there are cats etc etc. it was strange.

This is cats 101. grooming is already stressful for them, don’t have other cats around. So I’m pretty upset over this. When I go to pick up my cat, another lady was there picking her cat up, and her cat had peed. The cat owner said “do you think it’s because of the other cats?” And Amanda said no. lol. Bullllll!!

I will say, the quality of Amanda’s actual cut seems pretty good! I will not be back because it’s a stressful place. I don’t know if it’s this specific groomer, or the management or what. But there needs to be a better solution than having all the cats in one room.

I had an excellent experience bringing my Golden Retriever in for her first grooming appointment. The staff was incredibly friendly, and they did an outstanding job. The pricing was also very reasonable. Will be returning!
Love this neighborhood gem! We always know our pup will be in good hands here and come out looking fresh and clean. Thank you!
I’ve been going here for years with my pup, Durango. They’re friendly, quick, and so loving with the pups!

Hard to find a cat groomer and near impossible to find a good one.  My senior long-haired cat came here every few months for over a year.  Amanda always worked with how much my cat could handle on that day.  My cat passed recently and I'm having a difficult time expressing how grateful I am for how my cat was treated by Amanda.  We had been to other groomers, but I definitely felt the most comfortable taking her here. Highly recommend.
A neighborhood gem. I love taking my pup there

I’m from Chicago and have tried a handful of dog groomers around the city for my Mini Australian Shepherd and I am so glad to have found The Grooming Gallery, specifically the groomer Haley. She is kind, professional, and a great listener. She is great with dogs and my pup was immediately comfortable with her. I’ve found that Aussie’s tend to be complicated to groom but not for Haley, who was sure to ask questions and make great suggestions. I never have to worry about how my dog’s cut will go, she always comes out looking great. I’m very appreciative that I’ve found my go-to Groomer and highly recommend Haley, if you are lucky to have the opportunity.
Would give zero if I could, they were ready to set up an appointment until I told them my dog is a Samoyed. I was informed they are not taking any new Samoyed clients.
This place has taken care of my two doggies for years, and I totally trust and appreciate all the TLC that Eric and Amanda have given to my dogs.  Never had anything but a positive experience!
My 2yr old - 8lb dog spend about 3hrs at this groomer and not much was done to him 🐾, for us, not the best experience. …
